referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A bright automotive showroom page with a shallow wordmark/navigation row, a softly washed full-width showroom hero, a price/value promise, and a stock finder attached to the hero. Recent inventory is displayed as comparable vehicle records with image, model, specifications, and finance labels. Lower chapters explain payment assumptions, provide a part-exchange workflow, show branch utility details, and close with compliance text and navigation. All source cars, figures, branch facts, reviews, and claims are demo content.

heroGeometry.alignment: large left-aligned value statement over a wide lightened showroom image with finder attached below
heroGeometry.viewport: brand, clear value proposition, first stock-search fields and primary action fit in the opening desktop view

navigationGeometry.placement: shallow white strip above the showroom image
navigationGeometry.mobile: brand and compact menu remain; phone or enquiry route has one clear place

typography.scale: large two-line promise, clear model names, small metadata and explicit price labels

palette.contrastIntent: highly readable retail contrast with orange reserved for active search and actions

imageTreatment.mode: wide showroom context plus repeated vehicle records
imageTreatment.crop: soft cover hero followed by consistent product-image crops
imageTreatment.focalPoint: showroom context in hero; vehicle silhouette and model identity in inventory images

servicePresentation.pattern: inventory comparison with a separate payment explainer and part-exchange flow
servicePresentation.interaction: stock filters and finance controls only when connected to accurate inventory and finance data

ctaPlacement.primary: stock finder action within the opening scene
ctaPlacement.secondary: call or test-drive enquiry in utility navigation
ctaPlacement.early: within the hero, immediately after the value statement

motion.reducedMotion: show the complete stock list and static finance assumptions

mobileRecomposition.strategy: stacked retail search and inventory comparison
rules: put stock filters immediately below the promise
show model, verified specification, price label and action together
stack branch and finance data without sideways tables

prohibitedPatterns: copied vehicle names, photos, prices, finance or branch claims
stock photo presented as available inventory

requiredSignatureElements.description: search/filter controls attached to the showroom promise
vehicle records compared through image, model and verified details
separate finance assumptions or explainer, not an unsupported live price

acceptanceChecks: stock search is the primary opening action
vehicle imagery matches real client inventory or is explicitly illustrative
all payment inputs and assumptions are verified
branch details represent confirmed physical locations
mobile inventory is readable without horizontal scrolling
the page has a clear test-drive or vehicle-enquiry path

review.scope: pinned MIT template, per-image CC0/Public Domain evidence, full-page desktop/mobile captures, and transferable retail mechanics
